title: Hower
tagline: Accelerate task management by integrating AI-driven decision-making with onchain payments, categorizes tasks based on urgency and importance while incorporating financial incentives to ensure efficiency.
description: A dynamic task and financial management platform inspired by the Eisenhower Matrix but enhanced with automation, financial incentives, and collaborative decision-making. It helps users categorize their tasks based on urgency and importance while integrating monetary incentives to ensure that valuable work is rewarded, unworthy work is compensated, and priorities are managed effectively.
how_its_made:
Core Technologies

AI & Automation

Coinbase AgentKit & Coinbase Commerce → For MPC wallets, onchain payments, and automated payouts.

Base (L2 on Ethereum) → Deploying AI-powered automation on Base.

Privacy & Security

Nillion SecretVault → For private task/payment history storage.
